topic: Graphical Solution of Inequalities in Two Variables
title: Which Side Wins? Inequality Graphs Explained Simply | Class 11 Maths
description:
A coach draws one chalk line across the college ground, and every spot is now on one side of it, the other side, or on the line. Which side wins? In this animated lesson for Class 11 Maths (Chapter 5, Linear Inequalities) we solve inequalities in two variables with a graph. Note: this part was removed from the current rationalised NCERT text, so treat it as extra practice for coordinate geometry.

You will see the line x + y = 6 drawn on the plane, then watch a live test drop points one by one: true points land on one side, false points on the other, and the answer becomes a whole half plane. We use the origin as a test point, compare dashed and solid boundary lines, shade x > 2 and y < 3 on a plane, and work through 3x + 2y > 6 step by step. Two pause-and-think questions, the exam trap where greater than does not mean above, an original JEE Main pattern counting question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

Follows the NCERT book. Useful for CBSE, ICSE (ISC), Karnataka PUC and other state boards, and JEE.

In this video:

0:28 From a line to a region
1:00 Live: test every point

2:53 Worked example: 3x + 2y > 6
3:27 Exam trap: greater than is not always above
4:00 Practice question (JEE Main pattern)
4:38 Recap and three questions to answer
